title: Towards Reliable, Scalable, and Value-Aligned Generative Recommendation for Large-Scale Advertising
abstract: arXiv:2610.38378v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) reformulates item retrieval as autoregressive generation of discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs), offering a unified paradigm for personalized recommendation. GR4AD, as an industrial generative recommendation framework, has greatly improved advertising revenue while enabling efficient real-time serving in Kuaishou. However, continued deployment has exposed three limitations: deterministic SID assignment remains sensitive to semantic boundaries; conventional backbone scaling provides diminishing revenue gains under strict serving constraints; and sequence-level value optimization provides limited credit assignment to intermediate SID decisions, causing likelihood-based beam search to prematurely prune potentially high-value candidates. We present GR4AD-X, which addresses these limitations through reliable SID construction, serving-efficient capacity scaling, and unified value alignment. Specificall

translated_title: 面向大规模广告的可靠、可扩展且价值对齐的生成式推荐
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐（GR）将物品检索重新表述为对离散语义标识符（SIDs）的自回归生成，为个性化推荐提供了统一的范式。GR4AD作为一个工业级生成式推荐框架，已在快手显著提升广告收入，同时实现了高效的实时在线服务。然而，持续部署暴露出三个局限性：确定性的SID分配对语义边界仍然敏感；在严格的线上服务约束下，传统的主干网络扩展带来的收益逐渐递减；此外，序列级价值优化对中间SID决策的信用分配有限，导致基于似然的束搜索过早剪枝掉潜在的高价值候选。我们提出GR4AD-X，通过可靠的SID构建、服务高效的容量扩展以及统一的价值对齐来解决上述局限性。
tldr: 本文提出GR4AD-X框架，通过可靠的语义标识符构建、服务高效的容量扩展和统一的价值对齐，解决了工业生成式推荐框架GR4AD在SID分配对语义边界敏感、扩展收益递减以及价值信用分配不足导致高价值候选被过早剪枝这三大局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GR4AD-X, which addresses three limitations of the industrial generative recommendation framework GR4AD—sensitivity of deterministic SID assignment to semantic boundaries, diminishing returns from conventional backbone scaling, and limited credit assignment causing high-value candidates to be prematurely pruned—through reliable SID construction, serving-efficient capacity scaling, and unified value alignment.
